draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency was 41 ms per utterance (Corvex A2, fp16) versus Talmar's reported 118 ms (Corvex A1, fp32), a comparison limited by the different accelerators and precisions.
rationale: Numbers match T1 (41 vs 118 ms). However, latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), so "decodes faster" as a direct comparison is not fully established; the claim should note the differing measurement conditions.
